name: Zornade MCP - Italian Cadastre, Geospatial & Real Estate Data
description: Query Italian cadastral and geospatial data from any MCP client: geocoding on 18.7M+ addresses, enriched cadastral parcel profiles (risk, subsidence, valuation, solar), parcel lookup by coordinates or cadastral reference, and administrative lists. Free API key.
author: Zornade

tools.name: zornade_geocode_search
tools.description: Forward geocoding for Italian addresses. Searches the ANNCSU street archive (18.7+ million addresses) by street name and optional municipality. Returns matches with WGS84 coordinates, postal code, municipality, province and region. Does NOT find points of interest: search by street name instead.

q.description: Street name or search text, min 2 chars. Example: "Via del Corso"

tools.name: zornade_geocode_reverse
tools.description: Reverse geocoding: find Italian addresses near WGS84 coordinates. Returns the closest ANNCSU addresses with distance in meters.

radius.description: Search radius in meters, default 100, max 500

tools.name: zornade_parcel_by_id
tools.description: Enriched cadastral parcel profile by FID or GML ID. Returns municipality, area, cadastral reference, and the requested data sections (risk, subsidence, terrain, buildings, economics, demographics, valuation, valuation_history, solar, POI, etc.). Geometry is omitted to keep the reply compact.

fid.description: Parcel FID number (example "28009975") or GML ID

include.description: Comma-separated sections: risk,subsidence,terrain,population,buildings,economics,demographics,land_cover,land_use,valuation,valuation_history,coastal_erosion,cultural_heritage,poi,solar,nightlights,nightlights_v2. Default: risk,economics,solar,valuation. Use nightlights_v2 for night-time light: VIIRS sampled at the parcel's own point, requested by name (not part of all). nightlights is deprecated (removal 2027-04-12).

tools.name: zornade_parcel_locate
tools.description: Find cadastral parcels by coordinates or bounding box. Three modes: single point (lat+lng), multiple points (points="lat,lng;lat,lng", max 10), or bounding box (bbox="minLng,minLat,maxLng,maxLat", max 0.05 degrees per side). Returns matching parcels with FID, municipality and centroid.

bbox.description: Bounding box as "minLng,minLat,maxLng,maxLat", max 0.05 degrees per side

tools.name: zornade_parcel_search
tools.description: Search cadastral parcels by cadastral reference: municipality (fuzzy match), sheet number (foglio), parcel label, optional section. Returns matching parcels with FID, municipality, sheet, area and centroid.

tools.name: zornade_admin_lists
tools.description: Italian administrative reference data: regions, provinces, or municipalities. Provinces can be filtered by region; municipalities by province or region.
